description: Unverifiable numbers, credential claims with no documentation
page_text: We've delivered over 200 AI projects for Fortune 500 clients, achieving 95% accuracy improvements and $50M in cost savings. Our team holds security clearances and we're SOC 2 certified and FedRAMP authorized. We serve 8(a) set-aside contracts and maintain a GSA Schedule. Average project timeline: 6 weeks from kickoff to production deployment.
rationale: Numbers with no evidence anchor (200 projects, 95%, $50M, 6 weeks). Forbidden credential terms (security clearance, SOC 2, FedRAMP, 8(a), GSA). Unverifiable claims fail falsifiability.
